idioms: Laravel projects (artisan present): use artisan generators, Eloquent conventions, and the client's existing directory layout.
Match the client's PHP version constraint from composer.json and avoid newer syntax.
Use the client's test suite (PHPUnit vs Pest) — detect from composer require-dev.
Respect PSR-12 only if the client already follows it; otherwise mirror their style.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: imperative summary, link their issue.
never: Never run composer update (lockfile churn) — composer install only, unless dependency updates ARE the task.
